stories.title: NBA intel: KAT's next deal, expansion's next steps -- and why rival teams are watching Orlando
stories.summary: What storylines dominated the preseason? Brian Windhorst shares intel on Seattle expansion, extension drama in New York and a potential trade decision in Orlando.

stories.title: Jimmy Butler's mission to return to the Warriors: 'I felt I let them down'
stories.summary: After a quiet offseason, the Warriors know Butler's return is their best hope of reaching the playoffs.

stories.title: Packers RB Jacobs eligible to return next week amid ongoing probe
stories.summary: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.

stories.title: Broncos' Cooper removed from exempt list, could still face league discipline
stories.summary: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was removed from the commissioner exempt list Friday, meaning he's available to play in Week 7. Cooper, who was arrested twice in a seven-day span in June on domestic violence charges, has been on the list since Aug. 30.

stories.title: Eagles' beat-up backfield loses Barkley, Shipley; Smith likely to return
stories.summary: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.
